generalCriterionList.description: The agency shall quote the rates for 3 days for individual items.
Incomplete tenders are liable for rejection. Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Indicate item wise rates per unit is compulsory.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The right to accept or reject the tenders without assigning any reasons will be at the discretion of the University.
The Estimate is exclusive of GST 18% and will be paid separately
The successful bidder will be invited for negotiations if required and the work will be entrusted only after conducting the negotiations.

The contractor should make all the required arrangements to complete in all respects at least Three days prior to Totagarika Mela and maintain the same in good condition during Totagarika Mela scheduled from 23, 24 and 25 December 2026.
Good quality materials should be used for the stalls, superstructure, high tech stalls and all other components of the exhibition.

Use of fresh clean white cloth in the stalls is a must and clothes should be spread properly. Two bamboo poles to be tied between the stalls and cloth lining to be done on both sides of the economy stall.
The final settlement of bills shall be made to the contractor only after submission of proof for having paid service tax, education cess, income tax and other taxes applicable

The university reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity of any of the items listed in the tender based on the requirement. The rate for the additional quantity will be paid as per the quoted rate of the respective item. Any additional work if given should be attended by agency
The agency shall submit the detailed measurement sheet indicating actual work done at the site, before dismantling / removing the facilities.

The successful bidder has to deposit security deposit of 5% of the work order amount in the form FDR/DD/cheque drawn in favor of Comptroller UHS Bagalkot, which is refundable after the satisfactory completion of the work.

Additional performance security for unbalanced tender amount in the form of FDR/DD in favor of COMPTROLLER, UHS, Bagalkot issued from any nationalized bank. (Difference amount lesser than amount put to tender)
The agency is expected to visit the location of exhibition and get acquainted with the local conditions before quoting the rates.
Agency has to erect stall / fabricated structure etc., layout plan as per directions of exhibition committee.
If the quality of materials used is found unsatisfactory, then the payment for such items will not be made.
All works should be completed by 20.12.2026 afternoon without fail. If any inconvenient / delay in completion within the time limit penalty will be levied as per decision of the exhibition committee.
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-3.
The bidders are informed to visit KPPP portal for KW-3 manual and are to be abide by the conditions laid in the manual (No separate KW-3 manual is uploaded by this office)

It shall be the responsibility of the tenderers for the safety of the labourers deployed by them at work spot. University will not be responsible for any accidental injury death occurred to the labourers deployed by the tenderers.
The contractor has to upload the documents of Class-I Electrical Contractor license, Electrical Supervisor License and wireman license permit for carryout the electrical works.
The agency has to quote the rate inclusive of service, hiring charge, taxes, all lead and lift charge, transportation charges.
Providing electrification to the exhibition stalls and other facilities for 3 days by HESCOM or by Generators.
No-advances will be paid.
Any of the Universitys property should not be damaged. If damaged, suitable charges shall be deducted in the bills

The contractor is responsible for getting electrical connection for the Totagarika Mela exhibition and getting the prior permission / approval from HESCOM and Electrical inspectorate for the above electrical arrangements. The contractor should ensure 24 hrs continuous power supply during the entire period of Totagarika Mela by HESCOM or by generator. The agency has to pay the electricity charge before submission of bill, if HESCOM power is used.

It is the responsibility of the agency to ensure continuous power supply without interruption to all the stalls and in and around exhibition area through KEB / Conditioned acoustic DG sets backup. Operating cost including fuel is to be meet out by the contractor.
Streets lights are to be provided all around the exhibition area for good illumination.

To make provision for enough Number of fire extinguishers and ensure protection from fire hazards. The safety of the entire pendal and other related works of Totagarike Mela venue against all hazards will be solely the responsibility of the agency.
The contractor should ensure quality electrical wiring without bits and pieces to avoid short circuit problems and pass the UG cables through underground wherever necessary.
Wherever electrical tapping points are to be made proper control panel board along with necessary change over switch, ELCBs and MCCB electrical circuit has to be brought into circuit.
If the electrical work is found unsatisfactory, then 5% payment will be deducted from the final bill.
Electrical work during Mela should be carried out as per Electrical Inspectorate rules.
Proper grounding / earthing should be done for each electrical circuit and for DG Sets.

The bidders shall get updated/acquainted with ADDENDUM/CORRIGENDUM (if any) issued on-line from time to time on the e-procurement portal (https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in) during the entire tender process.
